explanation: Differentiating gives T′(t)=⟨−1/(t²+1)^(3/2),−t/(t²+1)^(3/2)⟩, so T′(0)=⟨−1,0⟩ and ‖T′(0)‖=1. The radius is R=‖r′(0)‖/‖T′(0)‖=2. The principal normal is N(0)=⟨−1,0⟩, hence the center is P+RN=(3,1)+2(−1,0)=(1,1).

answers.correct_value: The center is $⟨1,1⟩$ and the radius is $2$
answers.wrong_value: The center is $⟨3,3⟩$ and the radius is $2$
